text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During an interview with a magazine.
I received a few questions from a reporter, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What feelings do I pour into my Racewear?", huh.
Alright, I'll tell ya. It's—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Vast riches, it is!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I-Immense wealth...? Ah, I see!
You want to contribute that much to the Umamusume world!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous.
The only reason I want money is for my own ambitions.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"More treasure! More gold and silver riches!
That's my reason for running in this Racewear!"

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Wearing my racing silks
just for selfish desires is a bit much...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I get what you're trying to say.
Every Umamusume has their own reason to run, and I'm just doing me.
choice_data_list: (...Somehow, it feels like things are taking a turn for the worse.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days later, reading through the draft for review,
I discovered that my bad premonition had come true.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"For immense wealth. Seeing those sentiments woven
into her racing outfit, one can't help but wonder
about her true passion for racing—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! They're really dragging me through the mud!
Well, not a single word of it is a lie, though!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, it doesn't matter.
Because no one knows how wonderful my dream is better than I do.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even if no one else gets it, what we gotta do
doesn't change! Am I right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Are you frustrated?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will run the turf, amass immense wealth, and build a castle where I can dance the night away with my friends forever—"
That's what she told me when we first met.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I know those passionate feelings of hers...
My chest tightens.
choice_data_list: It frustrates me to see your dream being denied.
It pains me to see your dream being denied.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
That... changes things."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then for our next mock race,
why don't we invite a special guest!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for inviting me to another interview.
You mentioned I'd get to watch a mock race...?"
choice_data_list: Are you going to run in your racing outfit?
Are you going to run in your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "That's right! On this dress, I swear I will not put on a shameful run!"

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, relying on the racing racewear, huh... But she clearly stated it was for money, so..."

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Of course I would gladly
take a look, but—huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Such sheer determination...! Is this the running of an Umamusume who claimed to run purely for wealth...?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —I have a dream I want to make come true!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A massive dream that's burned into my heart and won't let go!
To make that dream come true, I need cash!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
These earrings, this necklace, even my tail ring!
Their golden shine is proof of that resolve!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, no matter how tough the opponent!
I'm gonna push forward together with this racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, reporter!
Even after all this, are you still gonna doubt my dream—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Don't you feel the "romance" in it?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...! I made a huge misunderstanding...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! That reporter's eyes went wide as saucers!
...Did a bit of our passion get through to them, I wonder?"
choice_data_list: I told you I don't care what other people think...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was the plan, but...
you're the one who went and fired me up!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I ever gave a damn
about what other people said about me, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Still... seeing how frustrated you looked made me think.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My dream was
your dream too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then how can I keep quiet?
When our friend's dream is being torn down like that!
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, why are you thanking me there?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're a friend who shares the same dream.
Doing this is only natural!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. An article about Tap Dance City read,
"The Umamusume who poured her resolve to achieve her dreams into her racing outfit."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now we're talking!
We grabbed this helm together,
so don't let go halfway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. An article about Tap Dance City read,
"The Umamusume who poured her resolve to achieve her dreams into her racing outfit."
